### Zevia Announces $20 Million Growth Equity Investment


October 22, 2026


*Funds Strategic Reset to Drive Long-Term Value Creation*


*Provides Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Results Ahead of Previous Guidance*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Zevia PBC (“Zevia” or the “Company”) (NYSE:ZVIA), the Company that provides naturally delicious, zero sugar better-for-you beverages, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement with a fund managed by GP Investments Ltd. (collectively, “GP Investments”) to issue convertible preferred stock in exchange for $20 million of growth equity to fund key strategic priorities to drive meaningful long-term value creation for shareholders.


The Company and its Board of Directors engaged Piper Sandler to thoroughly evaluate a broad range of strategic and financing alternatives over the past 12 months with a singular focus on maximizing shareholder value. Following a comprehensive review, Zevia’s management team and its Board of Directors determined that this growth equity investment represented the best path forward to accelerate shareholder value creation. The transaction strengthens Zevia’s balance sheet, enhances financial flexibility, and enables investment behind a stabilized and optimized platform, positioning the business to accelerate growth and drive long-term shareholder value. The new partnership with GP Investments also brings a long-term strategic partner and valuable industry perspective.


“This growth equity investment marks an important milestone in Zevia’s evolution and provides the capital, strategic resources, and operational expertise to accelerate our medium- and long-term growth agenda,” stated Alexandre Ruberti, Zevia’s Chief Executive Officer. “GP Investments brings a proven blueprint for building category-leading consumer businesses. The firm, founded in the early 1990s by the entrepreneurs behind ABInbev and 3G, brings that DNA blending active ownership, operational excellence, and disciplined capital allocation.”


Rodrigo Boscolo, CEO of GP Investments stated, “We are thrilled to partner with Zevia and help support accelerated profitable growth. The team’s execution strengths and clear growth plan give us confidence in Zevia’s potential to become a leading everyday alternative to traditional soda, as consumers increasingly seek healthier options without artificial sweeteners. As a healthier clean label better for you beverage alternative with a loyal consumer base and established retail presence, Zevia has a strong foundation to broaden its reach by expanding single-can availability, extending distribution and developing products for new consumption occasions.”


**Highlights of Zevia’s Strategic Reset**


***Accelerate Product Innovation to Enhance Better-for-You Beverage Positioning***


- Build a diversified product portfolio that unlocks new consumption occasions and broadens appeal among Gen Z and Millennial consumers.


- Accelerate consumer-led innovation that aligns with consumer preferences including functionality, enhanced taste, flavor variety, and overall brand relevance.
- Extend the platform into adjacent high-growth better-for-you beverage categories to capture incremental market share and expand the addressable market.


***Scale a Digital-First Ecosystem to Increase Consumer Engagement and Demand***


- Deploy a data-driven digital demand-generation strategy designed to accelerate retail and e-commerce growth.


- Shift marketing investment toward lower- and mid-funnel digital channels, including creators and micro-influencers, to improve conversion efficiency and customer acquisition.
- Deepen cultural relevance and expand share of conversation to strengthen brand affinity, elevate engagement, and increase purchase frequency.


***Execute a Hybrid Go-to-Market Strategy to Drive Household Penetration***


- Increase brand visibility, distribution reach, and ease of purchase to drive discovery, trial, and repeat purchase.


- Continued execution and investment behind the Company's proven West Coast direct store delivery (DSD) infrastructure.
- Strategic use of third-party merchandising partners in non-DSD markets to improve brand presence.
- Amplified efforts around e-commerce marketplaces to augment retail distribution.
- A targeted singles strategy to drive trial, supported by optimized multi-pack offerings that increase basket size and repeat purchase across retail and digital channels.


**Details of the Strategic Investment**


The investment is structured as Series A Senior Convertible Preferred Stock, convertible into Class A Common Stock at an initial conversion price equal to 120% of the volume-weighted average price over the 10 trading days preceding signing, underscoring GP Investments’ conviction in Zevia’s long-term value creation plan. The convertible preferred stock carries a 6% dividend, which will be payable in kind. GP Investments will designate a director to Zevia’s Board of Directors. Additional terms of the strategic investment by GP Investments are available in the Company’s filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.


Piper Sandler served as financial advisor to Zevia. Ropes & Gray LLP served as legal counsel to Zevia, and Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP served as legal counsel to GP Investments.


“Following a transformational two-year period focused on streamlining and strengthening the business, we now have a solid foundation to execute our next phase of growth,” said Girish Satya, Chief Financial Officer of Zevia. “This financing represents a pivotal step in that evolution, creating additional balance-sheet capacity, bringing in a seasoned investor with a strong track record of success across a broad range of consumer sectors and providing the flexibility to accelerate and capitalize on the tremendous opportunity to become the most trusted and chosen better-for-you brand in every category we serve.”


**Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Outlook**


The Company now expects third quarter 2026 net sales to be approximately $48 million, above its previous guidance range of $44 million to $46 million. Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be between negative $900 thousand and negative $1.0 million, above its prior guidance range of negative $3.0 million to negative $3.5 million. Zevia plans to report its third quarter 2026 financial results on November 4, 2026, after market close.


**About Zevia**


Zevia PBC is a Delaware public benefit corporation and Certified B Corporation offering a portfolio of naturally sweetened, better-for-you beverages made with simple, plant-based ingredients. Zevia® products are Non-GMO Project Verified, gluten-free, and vegan, and are distributed in more than 41,000 retail locations in the U.S. and Canada through a diverse network of major retailers in the grocery, drug, warehouse club, mass, natural, convenience and ecommerce channels. For more information, visit[www.zevia.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.zevia.com&esheet=54627461&newsitemid=20261022875458&lan=en-US&anchor=www.zevia.com&index=1&md5=dc8c0c88724c06c93ead5d8b26014df2) .


**About GP Investments**


GP Investments is a global investment platform with permanent capital and deep operating expertise. Established in 1993, the firm has deployed more than $5 billion and helped build and transform over 100 companies across sectors and geographies. GP partners with public and private companies, combining active ownership, operational expertise and disciplined capital allocation to create long-term value.


GP’s consumer investment experience spans food and beverage, health and wellness, and specialty retail. Investments include Fogo de Chão, the Brazilian steakhouse brand that GP helped expand across the United States; Hypera Pharma, a leading Brazilian consumer health company; and Grupo SBF, the Brazilian sporting goods retail group that owns Centauro and is Nike’s exclusive distributor in Brazil. GP was also a founding investor in The Craftory, a $550 million permanent-capital platform whose portfolio has included Hippeas, Seed Health, Needed and Edgard & Cooper.


With offices in New York, São Paulo and Bermuda, GP works alongside management teams to strengthen operations, build brands, expand distribution and pursue strategic partnerships. Its permanent capital provides flexibility and long-term perspective to support sustainable, profitable growth. More information is available at[www.gp-investments.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.gp-investments.com&esheet=54627461&newsitemid=20261022875458&lan=en-US&anchor=www.gp-investments.com&index=2&md5=4cd9596da3020a84c59dc45cc5000362) .
